version_bump: 0.3.0 (minor). Current 0.2.1. The batch adds user-visible features and commands: /onboarding (first-run wizard), /agents, the plan-approval gate in the gated graph (new human node, feedback loop), the live NOW row/narration/interactive /kpi status overlay, Firecrawl as a third research service with firecrawl_search, and new events.jsonl types (node.started, node.finished) plus schema fields (approval.result.feedback, accounts.json official/needsLogin). It also changes behaviour in ways operators will notice (a gated job without a dialog UI now stops NEEDS_HUMAN instead of being auto-denied; K-π no longer refreshes the auth.json grant; engine API submitHuman(HumanAnswer) and removed importOfficialCredentials/live-snapshot). Under semver a pre-1.0 minor bump is the correct signal for new features with compatible-but-changed behaviour; a patch (0.2.2) would understate new commands and event types, and 1.0.0 is not warranted while NH-03 and the product questions remain open. Bump both package.json (root) and packages/coding-agent/package.json to 0.3.0 in the final wave, after the anthropic-auth cherry-pick since the update remedy text names @korallis/k-pi@latest.
